description.content: Retrieves a list of all leads visible for a given context. You can filter the list using optional query parameters. Manual leads are visible to only those who created them. Company profile leads are visible to the Reseller that created the profile page as well as the Reseller Managers and Marketplace Managers. Product profile leads are visible to Marketplace Managers and Reseller Managers and can be configured so that the Developers who own the product profile can also see them.

query.description: (Required) Supported contexts
(Required) Company ID of the user who retrieved the list
Lead status
Search text, which filters the list of leads
Date on which the lead was created (lower bound) in Unix timestamp format
Date on which the lead was created (upper bound) in Unix timestamp format
The field by which to order the results
Type of ordering used (ascending or descending)
Page number
Number of results per page

response.name: Success

description.content:
Creates a manual, company profile or product profile lead. Manual leads are visible to only those who created them. Company profile leads are visible to the Reseller that created the profile page as well as the Reseller Managers and Marketplace Managers. Product profile leads are visible to Marketplace Managers and Reseller Managers and can be configured so that the Developers who own the product profile can also see them.
Required parameters:
Company name
Contact email
Lead type
Partner
If the lead type is PRODUCT, the product ID
If the lead type is COMPANY, the reseller company ID
The required parameter correspond to the request payload in [LeadCreationRequest](#leadcreationrequest)

query.description: (Required) The supported lead's API contexts. ANONYMOUS context can be used to create a PRODUCT or COMPANY lead without authentication.
(Required) Company ID of the user who is creating the lead. Only required when creating a lead of type MANUAL.

(Required) User ID of the user who is creating the lead. Only required when using OAuth credentials with role PARTNER to create a lead of type MANUAL. In this case, the user ID must correspond to a marketplace user who has the Marketplace Manager role. The user must be a member of a company that has marketplace access.
